interface.basis: The 26 MP stacked X-Trans CMOS 5 HS of the X-H2S. The stock 7.30 boot reads sensor registers without writing register 0x59 and never writes register 0, so neither the X-Trans 5 HR read gate nor its standby gate applies: the sensor answers reads and streams once programmed (observed on the strict boot; the gates themselves are unmeasured). Its fast readout is not decoded.
